roster.name: Quality Lead
roster.notes: Scope, objectives, requirements, risks, and acceptance criteria are complete and consistent. All OQs resolved. Causal chain from Context to Story Workshop is coherent.

roster.name: QA Gatekeeper
roster.notes: All hard gates met: OQ open count = 0, deferred items = 0, pack naming valid, Mermaid diagrams present, RCP rules correctly specified.

roster.name: Independent Reviewer
roster.notes: Cross-file consistency verified. Key decisions traceable across OQ register, delta log, requirements, and constraints. REQ-NFR boundary clean. Glossary terms consistent.

roster.name: Code Reviewer
roster.notes: Implementation-impacting decisions (diff strategy, stale heuristic, evidence schema) are well-defined and actionable for downstream SKILL.md authoring.

roster.name: Architect Reviewer
roster.notes: 3-layer additive architecture is technically consistent. Decision trade-offs documented with rejected options and recurrence prevention. Conservative detection strategy appropriate.

roster.name: QA Reviewer
roster.notes: Strong testability with concrete ACs, comprehensive edge case coverage (6 perspectives per story), explicit failure paths. All OQs resolved, 0 deferred.

roster.name: Frontend Reviewer
roster.notes: No frontend or UX impact. Discussion is entirely about SKILL.md prompt-level modifications. Screen Mock section is N/A.

roster.name: Backend Reviewer
roster.notes: Evidence schema extensions well-specified with backward compatibility. Operational and reliability concerns addressed through conservative detection and fallback mechanisms.

roster.name: Design Review Lead
roster.notes: Strong requirement/design coherence. Delta log functions as proper decision log with adoption rationale and rejection recurrence prevention. Information architecture supports downstream design.

roster.name: Runtime Gatekeeper
roster.notes: Multiple fallback layers for runtime risk. Rollback is straightforward (git revert, --full flag). Additive evidence schema poses no backward compatibility risk.
